title: BGP Support for Four-Octet Autonomous System (AS) Number Space

claims_extracted.claim: BGP is extended to support a four-octet AS number space while providing transition mechanisms for interaction with old speakers.
claims_extracted.notes: Preserve AS4_PATH, AS4_AGGREGATOR and AS_TRANS as separate transition mechanisms.

notes: Formal compatibility-oriented namespace expansion rather than a new BGP protocol generation.
